drafts.walkScript: In lines 13 and 14 Reuben returns a cardigan whose owner has left. Yet on line 33 his own jumper goes in "the Friday box". On line 47 he gives a size reason: "It won't fit me next year." But Miss Bhatt's long look on line 48 shows he is giving up on next year. The sheet on line 38 is for "September football trials", so he won't fill its space.
